ارتشفنا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَشَفْنَا (irtašafnā) /ir.ta.ʃaf.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
# اُرْتُشِفْنَا (urtušifnā) /ur.tu.ʃif.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
